description: Search Australian companies on ProductReview.com.au and collect their ratings and customer reviews.

category.description: Optional category shortcut for mode=searchCompanies. It is combined with the query, or used alone when the query is empty.
category.title: Category

companySlugs.description: Companies to collect reviews for (mode=getReviews). Accepts ProductReview.com.au listing URLs or slugs, e.g. 'amazon' or 'https://www.productreview.com.au/listings/nrma-car-insurance'.
companySlugs.title: Company slugs or URLs

dateFrom.description: Earliest review publication date (YYYY-MM-DD) in mode=getReviews.
dateFrom.title: Reviews published from

dateTo.description: Latest review publication date (YYYY-MM-DD) in mode=getReviews.
dateTo.title: Reviews published until

maxItems.description: Maximum number of company or review records to return (1-10,000).
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxRating.description: Only include reviews with at most this many stars (1-5).
maxRating.title: Maximum star rating

minRating.description: Only include reviews with at least this many stars (1-5).
minRating.title: Minimum star rating

mode.description: Search for companies, or collect the reviews of specific companies.
enumTitles: Search companies by keyword or category
mode.title: Mode

query.description: Keyword to search for, such as 'travel insurance' or 'online electronics'. Used in mode=searchCompanies.
query.title: Search query

reviewKeyword.description: Only include reviews whose text matches this keyword in mode=getReviews.
reviewKeyword.title: Review keyword

searchSort.description: Order of company results in mode=searchCompanies.
searchSort.title: Company sort order

verifiedOnly.description: Only include reviews from verified reviewers in mode=getReviews.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified reviews only

withAttachmentsOnly.description: Only include reviews that have at least one attached photo in mode=getReviews.
withAttachmentsOnly.title: Reviews with photos only

title: ProductReview.com.au Company Ratings & Reviews Input
